summary: Race-session scoring update. Runs only when ScoringGateCheck() passes, dword_8AB6E4 is not 2, and dword_7C56A4 equals 7. Reads a state word from the player vehicle pointer dword_7C54E8 at +16472, updates short-term scoring data via ShortComputation_2bf0, applies a running-average filter, conditionally feeds the AI difficulty value into ArithmeticComparison_2dc0 when dword_7D0990 > 0, and processes the race-setup scaling factor through sub_4C2D30. When championship mode dword_7D0410 is 4 or 3 and the vehicle state word equals 1, increments the session counter at this[15] (offset +0x3C). Returns dword_7D0410.

operations.description: ScoringGateCheck() decides whether scoring processing is allowed this invocation.
Proceed only when ScoringGateCheck() is non-zero, dword_8AB6E4 != 2, and dword_7C56A4 == 7 (race session type).
Read a state word into v3 from the player-vehicle pointer dword_7C54E8 at offset +16472.
ShortComputation_2bf0(this) updates short-term scoring state on this.
RunningAverageFilter(v3) applies the running-average filter to the player vehicle state word.
When dword_7D0990 > 0, cast dword_7D01A0 (AI difficulty) to float and pass it to ArithmeticComparison_2dc0.
sub_4C2D30(flt_7D0798) processes the race-setup scaling factor.
When dword_7D0410 (championship mode) is 4 or 3 and v3 == 1, increment the session counter this[15] at +0x3C.
Return dword_7D0410, or the ScoringGateCheck result when the outer guard fails.
